item.frontierhunts.hound_lead.tip1: Use: your own tracking hound · then: the command wheel
item.frontierhunts.hound_lead.tip2: Sneak-use: call him in · right-click him: sit / stand · sneak-right-click him: command wheel
item.frontierhunts.hound_lead.tip3: Use while aiming at blood or prints: put him on that line
hound.frontierhunts.said.new: %1$s, your %2$s, is at your heel. Right-click him to sit / stand him up. Tap %3$s to call him, hold it (or sneak-right-click him) for orders: Heel, Sit, Stop, Track, Search, Come, Dismiss.
hound.frontierhunts.said.search: %s ranges out to find fresh deer scent · follow him
hound.frontierhunts.said.track: %s drops his nose on your %s's line · follow the bawl
hound.frontierhunts.said.sign: %s takes the line from the nearest %s · follow the bawl
hound.frontierhunts.said.nothing: Nothing for him to track here · wound an animal, or aim the Hound Lead at blood or prints
hound.frontierhunts.said.off: Tracking is switched off here (gamerule frontierTracking)
hound.frontierhunts.said.none: You have no hound yet · use a Hound Lead
hound.frontierhunts.said.far: Your hound is out of earshot · last seen near %s, %s
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.title: Hound commands
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.stay.hint: Sit and stay here (lies down after a while)
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.track.hint: Run the blood of the animal you hit (or the nearest fresh sign)
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.search.hint: Range out, find fresh deer scent and lead you to them
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.foot: Point and click · 1-7 · Esc to close
hound.frontierhunts.wheel.foot_hold: Point and let go of the key · 1-7
